checks.title: Scicon Fly Lab
checks.guideText:
Selected controller: Random baseline

This baseline records gameplay without a learning model. Running it longer does not train the fly.

What do the gates mean?
Numerical: do the simulation equations behave correctly?
Vision: do pictures produce useful, reproducible responses?
Decoder: can those responses cause the declared actions?
Conditioning: do paired cues and rewards produce a specific memory?
Learning: does performance improve against the required controls?

Gates are measured results for a particular model, not settings to switch on. A reference-model result does not automatically validate our MaleCNS controller. The current numerical pass covers reference equations only.
